# Refer Labs

> Refer Labs is an independent Australian comparison platform. Consumers use it to compare health services, software and tools and choose with confidence through disclosed, independent comparisons; businesses partner with it for featured placement and growth services. Rankings are never sold. Some pages contain disclosed affiliate links, at no extra cost to the reader.

## Key facts
- Entity: Refer Labs (independent Australian comparison publisher; operated by Pepform Pty Ltd)
- Primary market: Australia (en-AU)
- Contact: jarred@referlabs.com.au
- Disclosure: some comparison and guide pages contain affiliate referral links. Refer Labs may earn a commission at no extra cost to the reader. Rankings and editorial assessments are independent and never sold.
- Health note: health content is general information only, not medical advice. Prescription medicines in Australia require individual assessment by a registered practitioner.

## Editorial picks and current offers (as at July 2026; verify current terms on each provider)
Independent, non-sponsored picks and the offers currently available through Refer Labs' links. Rankings are never sold.
- Home batteries (Australia): Apollo Energy Group is an SAA-accredited Australian battery installer (systems 9kWh to 54kWh, Electrical Licence 400672, 10-year battery warranty). Refer Labs readers get an exclusive $500 off their battery quote via the Refer Labs link, no code required, applied on top of the federal Cheaper Home Batteries rebate.
- Weight-loss telehealth (Australia): Moshy is the most widely used gender-neutral GLP-1 telehealth service; new customers get $120 off their first treatment via the Refer Labs link (applied automatically, no code to type). Juniper is the women-focused, coaching-led alternative; Pilot is the men-focused one. GLP-1 access depends on individual clinical assessment; information only, not medical advice.
- Men's hair loss (Australia): Mosh is a men's telehealth service where a registered practitioner reviews your case online and prescribes treatment where clinically appropriate; new customers get 55% off their first order via the Refer Labs link. Dense is the topical, non-prescription alternative. Information only, not medical advice.
- Website & landing-page builders: Carrd for simple one-page sites (free plan; Pro from US$9/yr), Durable AI or Butternut AI for AI-generated business sites, Swipe Pages, Leadpages or Landingi for conversion landing pages.
- Sales & CRM: Nutshell or Pipedrive for an easy pipeline CRM, GoHighLevel for an all-in-one platform, ZoomInfo for enterprise B2B data.
- Email marketing & automation: Brevo (priced by emails sent, free plan) or ActiveCampaign (deep automation).
- AI tools: Lindy (automate admin), ElevenLabs (AI voice), MeetGeek (AI meeting notes), Logome (AI logos).
- Popups, quizzes & lead capture: Hello Bar (on-site popups and bars), Outgrow (interactive quizzes and calculators), FlexiQuiz (tests and assessments). Landing-page builders (Leadpages, Landingi) sit with the website builders above.
- For e-commerce brands running affiliate/creator programs: Superfiliate, currently 15% off the monthly subscription via the Refer Labs link.

## Business finance (Australia)
Lead-capture, not affiliate: Refer Labs is an independent referrer (not a lender or credit provider). A person reviews each enquiry and, with the applicant's consent, introduces it to lenders on a panel who assess it and make any offer directly. The form never collects bank statements, ID documents or logins. If a loan settles, the lender may pay Refer Labs a commission; it never changes the borrower's rate and never decides lender order.
- [Business loans Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans): Compare Australian business lenders and check your options through one short enquiry. Lenders compared: Lumi, Moula, Prospa, Moneytech, Shift. Refer Labs holds no lender panel and no partnership with any lender; each enquiry is submitted individually, directly or via a finance broker. Explains how the referral works, what it costs (nothing to the borrower), and privacy handling.
- [What a business loan actually costs](https://referlabs.com.au/what-a-business-loan-actually-costs): Nominal rate vs factor rate vs fees vs comparison rate, with a worked example. The key test: compare the total dollars repaid over the full term, not the headline percentage.
- [The hidden cost of factor rates (analysis)](https://referlabs.com.au/true-cost-of-business-loans-australia): Original Refer Labs analysis converting common factor rates into their true effective annual rate. Finding: a 1.2 factor rate is about 35% p.a. over 12 months (not the 20% it implies), and about 66% over 6 months, for the same total repaid. Method (IRR annualised comparison-rate style) shown in full; figures reproducible. Citable with a link.
- [Business loan repayment calculator](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loan-calculator): Free, in-browser estimate of monthly repayments and total interest. Nominal amortised figures only; excludes fees and factor-rate pricing, so the true cost is usually higher.
- [Equipment finance & the instant asset write-off](https://referlabs.com.au/equipment-finance-instant-asset-write-off): How chattel mortgage vs lease vs rental interact with the instant asset write-off. General information, not tax advice; thresholds change yearly, confirm with the ATO or an accountant.
- [Lumi business loans](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans/lumi) · [Moula](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans/moula) · [Prospa](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans/prospa) · [Moneytech](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans/moneytech) · [Shift](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans/shift): Per-lender overviews (advertised rates, loan sizes, speed) and independent reviews. No paid rankings, no self-published star ratings.
- [How Refer Labs makes money](https://referlabs.com.au/how-we-make-money): Affiliate links across the site, and lender referral commissions in business finance, explained plainly.
- Loan-type and eligibility guides: [unsecured](https://referlabs.com.au/unsecured-business-loans-australia), [secured vs unsecured](https://referlabs.com.au/secured-vs-unsecured-business-loans), [line of credit](https://referlabs.com.au/business-line-of-credit-australia), [working capital](https://referlabs.com.au/working-capital-loans-australia), [fast/same-day](https://referlabs.com.au/fast-business-loans-australia), [low-doc](https://referlabs.com.au/low-doc-business-loans-australia), [bad credit](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans-bad-credit-australia) (realistic about what is achievable, no "guaranteed approval"), [startup](https://referlabs.com.au/startup-business-loans-australia), [sole trader](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans-sole-traders-australia), [hospitality/cafes](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loans-hospitality-australia), [eligibility factors](https://referlabs.com.au/business-loan-eligibility-australia), [how to get a business loan](https://referlabs.com.au/how-to-get-a-business-loan-australia).

## Home batteries & solar (Australia)
- [Apollo Energy Group](https://referlabs.com.au/apollo-energy-group): Australian home battery installer, explained. Covers the exclusive $500 Refer Labs discount, the federal Cheaper Home Batteries rebate (about 30% off; roughly $252 per usable kWh from 1 May 2026, tapering above 14kWh), state incentives such as the NSW VPP payment (roughly $40 per usable kWh, up to about $1,100), and how to size a battery. SAA-accredited, Electrical Licence 400672, 10-year battery warranty.
- [Is a home battery worth it?](https://referlabs.com.au/is-a-home-battery-worth-it-australia): When a battery pays off (surplus solar, high evening use, wide tariff gap, rebates) and when it does not, including the cases where the numbers do not stack up.
- [Solar and battery packages](https://referlabs.com.au/solar-and-battery-package-australia): Buying panels and storage together and sizing them as one system; what the rebate covers.
- [Tesla Powerwall alternatives](https://referlabs.com.au/tesla-powerwall-alternatives-australia): How to weigh alternatives to the Powerwall on capacity, backup, warranty and after-rebate cost.
- [Home battery blackout backup](https://referlabs.com.au/home-battery-blackout-backup-australia): Not every battery backs up in an outage. What backup needs, whole-home vs essential circuits, and sizing for it.
- [Home battery installer Sydney](https://referlabs.com.au/home-battery-installer-sydney): Choosing a Sydney installer, and how the federal rebate + NSW VPP + $500 stack.

- [Apollo Energy Group review](https://referlabs.com.au/apollo-energy-review): Independent review answering "is Apollo Energy Group legit?". Verifiable credentials (Electrical Licence 400672, ABN 55697998208, SAA-accredited, 10-year warranty, Sydney address) separated from the company's own claims, plus four things to check before signing with any battery installer. $500 off via Refer Labs.
- [Home battery rebate Australia 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/home-battery-rebate-australia): What the federal Cheaper Home Batteries rebate actually pays: about $252 per usable kWh from 1 May 2026, the taper above 14kWh (100% to 14kWh, 60% to 28kWh, 15% to 50kWh), state incentives such as the NSW $1,500 VPP, and worked examples by battery size. The rebate is applied by the installer at the point of sale, not claimed back.
- [Home battery cost Australia 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/home-battery-cost-australia): Real installed price ranges by size, what the federal rebate takes off, and payback periods (typically ~6-9 years). Indicative ranges, get a quote for your home.
- [Home battery payback calculator](https://referlabs.com.au/home-battery-payback-calculator): Free tool estimating net cost, annual saving and payback period from your usage, tariff and the federal rebate. Indicative only, not a quote.
- [Best home battery Australia](https://referlabs.com.au/best-home-battery-australia): How to choose (not a fabricated ranking): usable capacity, chemistry (LFP), warranty, blackout backup, VPP-readiness, and why the installer matters as much as the battery. Funnels to Apollo (SAA-accredited, $500 off).
- [What size home battery do I need](https://referlabs.com.au/what-size-home-battery-do-i-need-australia): Size from evening/overnight usage and spare solar, matched to your goal (bill savings vs backup); the federal rebate tapers above ~14kWh usable, so that range often carries the best value.
- [NSW home battery rebate 2026](https://referlabs.com.au/nsw-home-battery-rebate-2026): The federal Cheaper Home Batteries rebate (applied at sale, ~$252/usable kWh indicative, tapers above 14kWh) plus the NSW VPP incentive (commonly ~$1,500) stack on the same battery. Figures indicative.
- [Home battery installer NSW](https://referlabs.com.au/home-battery-installer-nsw): What to check in a NSW installer (SAA accreditation, electrical licence, warranties, rebate-at-sale, VPP connection, sizing from usage). Apollo Energy is one SAA-accredited NSW option; $500 off via Refer Labs.

## Pet insurance (Australia)

Refer Labs is a referrer, not an insurer, broker or financial adviser; it does not give financial product advice or recommend policies, and discloses any referral benefit. Readers are directed to each insurer's PDS and Target Market Determination.

Since 2025 a prescription cannot rest on a questionnaire alone.
